title_zh: 全球健康与长寿每日简报
intro_zh: 每日汇总功能医学、长寿医学、精准营养、营养补剂与健康管理五大领域的中英文权威资讯，每条附原始出处链接。
intro_en: A daily digest of authoritative Chinese and international coverage across functional medicine, longevity medicine, precision nutrition, dietary supplements and health management — every item links to its original source.

items.title_zh: 一个菌群「风险排序谱」：12 种慢病可无创同筛，两项 AUC 超 0.95
items.title_en: One stool sample, twelve diseases: a microbiome index ranks chronic disease risk
items.source_en: China Gut Daily via Tencent News
items.summary_zh: 同济大学吴顶峰、尹文靖团队构建 SPECTRA 模型，把 12 个维度菌群指数整合成「风险排序谱」：内部验证平均 AUC 0.92、外部 0.79，血压异常与动脉粥样硬化性心血管病分别达 0.96、0.95；取前三种病时准确率超 96%，对未训练过的病种仍有 0.85。团队已开放 xMICARE 平台，但研究为横断面，尚不能判断因果。
items.summary_en: Wu Dingfeng and Yin Wenjing's team at Tongji University built SPECTRA, a multi-output random-forest model that turns 12 microbiome indices into a ranked risk profile across 12 chronic diseases. Mean AUC reached 0.92 internally and 0.79 in external validation, with 0.96 for abnormal blood pressure and 0.95 for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease; accuracy exceeded 96% when the top three candidates were considered, and held at 0.85 for diseases the model had never seen. The xMICARE platform is open to researchers, but the data are cross-sectional, so causality remains unknown.

items.title_zh: 饮食失调「从肠计议」：前瞻研究找到暴食发生的菌群风险信号
items.title_en: Eating disorders through the gut: prospective data flag microbiome risk signals for binge eating
items.summary_zh: 西南大学陈红团队与斯坦福大学 Eric Stice 合作，在《国际进食障碍杂志》发表前瞻研究，把纵向分组分析与鸟枪法宏基因组测序结合。暴食发展者整体菌群多样性无差异，但放线菌门及 11 个属丰度下降，个别弯曲杆菌种升高；清除症状发展者 Roseburia 明显减少。暴食持续者萜类与聚酮类代谢通路更富集，提示菌群可作风险与维持信号。
items.summary_en: Chen Hong's group at Southwest University, working with Eric Stice of Stanford, published a prospective study in the International Journal of Eating Disorders combining longitudinal group analysis with shotgun metagenomic sequencing. In people who went on to develop binge eating, overall diversity did not differ, but Actinobacteria and 11 genera were depleted and certain Campylobacter species rose; those developing purging symptoms showed lower Roseburia. In persistent binge eating, terpenoid and polyketide pathways were enriched — suggesting microbial signals for both risk and maintenance.

items.title_zh: 千人肠道脂质代谢图谱：小肠菌群的「解脂」基因比结肠更丰富
items.title_en: A thousand-gut lipid map: small-intestine microbes carry richer fat-metabolising gene repertoires
items.source_en: China Gut Daily via Tencent News
items.summary_zh: 瓦格宁根大学 Laura C. Valk 团队在《肠道微生物》发表研究，用 88 个隐马尔可夫模型解析逾千份人类宏基因组，系统绘制肠道菌脂质转化基因图谱。小肠菌群脂质代谢基因丰富度显著高于结肠；拟杆菌属肠型 2 富集甾醇磺化与胆碱转化基因，其丰度与血清熊去氧胆酸及磺化衍生物正相关，提示上消化道菌群直接影响宿主心血管代谢。
items.summary_en: Laura C. Valk's team at Wageningen University published in Gut Microbes a map built from more than 1,000 human metagenomes using 88 hidden Markov models. Lipid-metabolism gene richness was markedly higher in the small intestine than the colon. Bacteroides enterotype 2 was enriched for sterol-sulfation and choline-conversion genes, and that abundance correlated with serum ursodeoxycholic acid and its sulfated derivatives — pointing to upper-gut microbes as direct modulators of host cardiometabolic health.

items.title_zh: 抓住生命早期窗口：工程益生菌一次接种可长期定植
items.title_en: Seeding the newborn gut: a single dose lets engineered probiotics colonise long term
items.source_en: China Gut Daily via Tencent News
items.summary_zh: 上海交大孙冬雷、肖毅团队在《ISME 杂志》比较三种工程化大肠杆菌，发现 8 日龄新生小鼠肠道存在「生态窗口」：共生株 EcWJ 与益生菌株 EcN 可在隐窝长期富集，实验室株 MG1655 则被快速清除——后者强烈招募巨噬细胞与中性粒细胞，回补 wbbL 恢复 O 抗原可延长定植。定植强度并不等于疗效，底盘与功能需匹配。
items.summary_en: Sun Donglei and Xiao Yi's team at Shanghai Jiao Tong University compared three engineered E. coli strains in the ISME Journal and found an ecological window in 8-day-old mice: the commensal strain EcWJ and probiotic strain EcN persisted in crypts, while lab strain MG1655 was cleared quickly after recruiting macrophages and neutrophils; restoring O-antigen synthesis via wbbL extended colonisation. Colonisation strength did not equal efficacy — chassis and payload must match.

items.title_zh: 长寿医学中心落地：把抗衰干预窗口定在 45 岁，先开记忆门诊
items.title_en: A longevity medicine centre opens in Shanghai, setting the anti-ageing window at 45
items.summary_zh: 11 月 20 日，复旦大学附属华东医院在建院百年学术交流会上启动长寿医学中心，联合上海国际人类表型组研究院发起「衰老干预与长寿队列研究」。院长保志军提出抗衰最佳干预年龄约 45 岁，中心将开设记忆门诊与早筛门诊，构建生物学年龄与功能储备动态评估及数字孪生人；同期发布《老年医学与人工智能融合发展白皮书》。
items.summary_en: On Nov 20, Fudan University's Huadong Hospital launched a longevity medicine centre at its centenary academic meeting, teaming with the Shanghai Institute of International Human Phenomics on a cohort study of ageing intervention and longevity. President Bao Zhijun put the optimal anti-ageing window at about 45 and said the centre will open memory and early-screening clinics, build dynamic biological-age and functional-reserve assessment and a digital twin, and released a white paper on AI in geriatric medicine.

items.title_zh: 生物学年龄每升一档，慢阻肺合并肌少症风险翻倍：CHARLS 4204 人
items.title_en: Higher biological age doubles the odds of sarcopenia in COPD: 4,204-person CHARLS analysis
items.summary_zh: 山东大学齐鲁医院姜园园团队利用 CHARLS 数据，纳入 4204 名参与者分析生物学年龄与慢阻肺合并肌少症的关联。充分校正后生物学年龄与共病显著正相关（OR 2.52）；限制性立方样条显示关系近似线性，分段回归找到约 60.26 岁的阈值，阈值以下风险随生物学年龄明显升高（OR 1.35），提示加速生物学老化是该共病的关键驱动。
items.summary_en: Jiang Yuanyuan's team at Qilu Hospital of Shandong University used CHARLS data on 4,204 participants to link biological age with sarcopenia in COPD. After full adjustment the association was strong (OR 2.52); restricted cubic splines showed a near-linear relationship, and segmented regression identified a threshold near 60.26 years, below which risk rose clearly with biological age (OR 1.35). Accelerated biological ageing appears to be a key driver of this comorbidity.

items.title_zh: 只烧脂肪不烧肌肉：新化合物把能量消耗提高 18%
items.title_en: Fat without the muscle: an experimental compound lifts energy expenditure by 18%
items.summary_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校在《科学进展》报告化合物 TOFA：既抑制乙酰辅酶 A 羧化酶减少脂肪合成，又激活 PPARα/δ 促进脂肪燃烧，使小鼠能量消耗最多增加 18%，且未增加活动量或体温。肥胖小鼠减重以脂肪为主、瘦体重流失不显著，血糖与甘油三酯改善；与司美格鲁肽、替尔泊肽联用优于单药。目前仅动物数据。
items.summary_en: UC Berkeley reported in Science Advances on TOFA, which both inhibits acetyl-CoA carboxylase to curb fat synthesis and activates PPAR alpha/delta to drive fat burning, raising energy expenditure in mice by up to 18% without extra activity or higher body temperature. Obese mice lost mainly fat with little lean-mass loss, and glucose and triglycerides improved; combining it with semaglutide or tirzepatide beat either alone. Human data do not yet exist.

items.title_zh: 适度低温激活一条 BH2 代谢网络：线虫延寿，蛋白稳态更稳
items.title_en: Mild cold switches on a BH2 metabolic network that extends lifespan and protects proteostasis
items.summary_zh: 《自然》刊发的研究显示，适度低温可激活以 BH2 为核心的代谢网络，延长线虫寿命、抑制衰老相关有害蛋白聚集，并帮助维持远端组织的蛋白稳态。同期《糖尿病学》人体试验中，超重或肥胖的 2 型糖尿病患者接受一次轻度冷刺激（15℃ 水冷服）后，24 小时连续血糖监测显示血糖改善，糖尿病前期组则不明显。作者提示样本小，不宜外推。
items.summary_en: A Nature study reports that mild cold activates a BH2-centred metabolic network, extending lifespan in C. elegans, suppressing age-related toxic protein aggregation and preserving proteostasis in distant tissues. In a companion Diabetologia trial, one session of mild cold (a 15C water-cooled suit) improved 24-hour continuous glucose readings in overweight or obese adults with type 2 diabetes, but not in prediabetes. The authors caution that samples were small.

items.title_zh: 同样是生酮，蛋白占比 5% 还是 10% 决定减重还是血糖变差
items.title_en: Same ketogenic diet, different protein share: 5% versus 10% flips the metabolic outcome
items.summary_zh: 良渚实验室张昭悦与洛克菲勒大学 Jeffrey Friedman 团队在《细胞代谢》比较两种生酮配方：蛋白供能 5% 使 C57BL/6J 小鼠摄食大减、体重与血糖下降；10% 反而促脂肪积累并损害糖耐量。近缘品系 B6NJ 对低蛋白生酮无明显减重反应。机制指向 Nnt 缺失引发肝脏氧化应激与 GDF15 升高，叠加 Nlrp12 突变促炎的 LCN2 上升，NAC 可部分逆转。
items.summary_en: Zhang Zhaoyue of the Liangzhu Laboratory and Jeffrey Friedman's Rockefeller group compared two ketogenic formulas in Cell Metabolism: 5% protein energy sharply cut intake and lowered weight and glucose in C57BL/6J mice, while 10% promoted fat gain and impaired glucose tolerance. The related B6NJ strain showed no such weight loss. The mechanism runs through Nnt deficiency driving hepatic oxidative stress and GDF15, plus Nlrp12-mutant inflammation raising LCN2; NAC partly reversed it.

items.title_zh: 65 岁以上糖尿病人三分之二蛋白吃不够，用 GLP-1 者更低
items.title_en: Two-thirds of older adults with type 2 diabetes miss protein targets, and GLP-1 users fare worse
items.summary_zh: 马萨诸塞大学团队分析 NHANES 2017—2020 中 673 名接受药物治疗的 2 型糖尿病成人，样本代表约 1840 万人。20—64 岁组日均蛋白 0.89 g/kg，达到 0.8 g/kg 推荐；65 岁以上仅 0.87 g/kg，低于老年推荐下限 1.0 g/kg，其中 67% 未达最低标准。使用 GLP-1 受体激动剂者日均 0.74 g/kg，校正后差异收窄且不显著（该组仅 38 人）。
items.summary_en: A University of Massachusetts team analysed 673 pharmacologically treated adults with type 2 diabetes in NHANES 2017-2020, representative of about 18.4 million people. Those aged 20-64 averaged 0.89 g/kg of protein daily, meeting the 0.8 g/kg reference; those 65 and older averaged only 0.87 g/kg, below the 1.0 g/kg older-adult floor, and 67% missed even the minimum. GLP-1 users averaged 0.74 g/kg, a gap that shrank and lost significance after adjustment (only 38 users).

items.title_zh: 3.5 克抗性土豆淀粉 4 周：双歧杆菌上升，排便形态改善
items.title_en: 3.5 g of resistant potato starch for four weeks lifts Bifidobacterium and normalises stool form
items.summary_zh: 加拿大圭尔夫大学在《营养素》发表重复性随机双盲对照试验，70 名 18—69 岁健康成人每日 3.5 克 Solnul 抗性土豆淀粉或安慰剂，持续 4 周。16S 测序显示双歧杆菌相对丰度显著上升（p=0.049），正常粪便（Bristol 3—4 型）次数更多（p=0.0077）；Akkermansia 与安慰剂相比无差异，但组内较基线升高。无严重不良事件。
items.summary_en: The University of Guelph published a replication randomised double-blind trial in Nutrients: 70 healthy adults aged 18-69 took 3.5 g of Solnul resistant potato starch or placebo daily for four weeks. 16S sequencing showed a significant rise in Bifidobacterium (p=0.049) and more normal stools on the Bristol scale (p=0.0077). Akkermansia did not differ from placebo, though it rose from baseline within the starch arm. No serious adverse events were reported.

items.title_zh: 吃得更少不等于吃得够：GLP-1 使用者的微量营养缺口
items.title_en: Eating less is not eating enough: micronutrient gaps among GLP-1 users
items.source_en: Men's Journal / BMJ Nutrition, Prevention & Health
items.summary_zh: 发表于《BMJ 营养、预防与健康》的小样本研究记录英国一家诊所 14 名使用食欲抑制药物者的两日膳食：逾 75% 纤维与维生素 D 摄入不足，一半低于研究设定的铁阈值，8 人至少三种关键营养素明显不达标，无一人达到每日果蔬建议；部分人出现头晕与低血压，且缺乏后续营养随访。作者强调样本小、属观察性，不能推因果。
items.summary_en: A small study in BMJ Nutrition, Prevention & Health recorded two days of dietary intake for 14 patients on appetite-suppressing medication at an English practice: more than 75% fell short on fibre and vitamin D, half were below the study's iron threshold, eight missed at least three key nutrients, and none met fruit and vegetable targets. Some reported dizziness and low blood pressure, with little nutrition follow-up. The authors stress the sample is small and observational.

items.title_zh: 同样是鱼油，咀嚼乳剂比软胶囊吸收快、峰值高五成
items.title_en: Same fish oil, different form: chewable emulsions beat soft-gels on absorption
items.source_zh: The Vagabond News（欧洲脂质科学与技术杂志）
items.source_en: The Vagabond News / European Journal of Lipid Science and Technology
items.summary_zh: 荷兰瓦格宁根大学 Renger Witkamp 团队在《欧洲脂质科学与技术杂志》发表随机交叉试验：12 名健康成人单次服用含 1.1 克 EPA+DHA 的鱼油，比较咀嚼乳剂与软胶囊，洗脱期一周。乳剂组总吸收量高约 25%，EPA 与 DHA 血药峰值高约 50% 且达峰更快。作者认为预乳化增加了酶作用的表面积，但仍需更大样本验证。
items.summary_en: Renger Witkamp's team at Wageningen University published a randomised crossover trial in the European Journal of Lipid Science and Technology: 12 healthy adults took a single 1.1 g EPA plus DHA dose as a chewable emulsion or a soft-gel, with a one-week washout. The emulsion raised overall absorption by about 25% and peak EPA and DHA levels by roughly 50%, reached faster. Pre-emulsification increases enzyme surface area, though larger trials are needed.

items.title_zh: 全球调查：一半更年期女性靠膳食补充剂缓解症状
items.title_en: Global survey: one in two women use supplements for menopause symptoms
items.summary_zh: 由 Galderma 资助、发表于《皮肤外科》的九国在线调查纳入 4303 名 45—60 岁围绝经期与绝经期女性：51% 曾服用膳食补充剂缓解症状，47% 使用日常护肤、46% 调整饮食、44% 运动，仅 17% 选择激素替代治疗。59% 认为更年期加重面部皱纹，58% 感到松弛、56% 干燥；60% 认为影响外貌吸引力，57% 出现焦虑或情绪低落。
items.summary_en: A nine-country online survey funded by Galderma and published in Dermatologic Surgery questioned 4,303 perimenopausal and menopausal women aged 45-60: 51% had taken dietary supplements for symptoms, 47% used daily skincare, 46% changed diet and 44% exercised, while only 17% chose hormone therapy. 59% said menopause worsened facial wrinkles, 58% reported loss of firmness and 56% dryness; 60% felt it hurt perceived attractiveness and 57% reported anxiety or low mood.

items.title_zh: 龙岩特殊食品全链条监管：网络监测 42 期，涉老案件 31 起
items.title_en: Longyan tightens special-food oversight: 42 monitoring rounds, 31 cases targeting older consumers
items.source_zh: 中国消费网（中国消费者报）
items.summary_zh: 福建龙岩市市场监管部门通报：截至 11 月 18 日，依托智慧监管平台开展网络监测 42 期、筛查商品信息 5023 条、排查私域直播线索 23 条、下架违规短视频与商品链接 13 条、网络抽检 424 批次；查处线上涉老违法案件 19 起、线下 12 起，移送公安 1 起，排查保健食品门店与涉老营销场所 490 户。母婴店同步推进 AI 可视化监管。
items.summary_en: Market regulators in Longyan, Fujian reported that by Nov 18 they had run 42 rounds of online monitoring, screened 5,023 product listings, traced 23 private-stream livestream leads, removed 13 non-compliant videos and product links, and conducted 424 online sampling tests. They handled 19 online and 12 offline cases targeting older consumers, referred one to police, and inspected 490 supplement stores and senior-focused marketing venues, while piloting AI visual oversight in baby-product shops.

items.title_zh: 60 人 12 周：胶原加姜黄加骨粉复方，改善运动性膝痛耐受
items.title_en: Collagen, curcumin and bone powder blend improves pain-limited knee loading: 60-person pilot
items.summary_zh: 南开大学团队在《营养素》发表先导性随机双盲安慰剂对照试验，60 名有运动相关膝部不适的耐力训练成人分三组：复方（非变性 II 型胶原、姜黄素磷脂复合物、酶解骨粉）、氨糖加软骨素、安慰剂，服用 12 周。12 周时复方组在单腿下台阶至疼痛 2 分与 5 分的次数及 VAS 疼痛上均优于安慰剂；半马后仅复方组关节活动度未下降。
items.summary_en: A Nankai University team published a pilot randomised double-blind placebo-controlled trial in Nutrients: 60 endurance-trained adults with activity-related knee discomfort took a multi-ingredient formula (undenatured type II collagen, curcumin phytosome, hydrolysed bone powder), glucosamine plus chondroitin, or placebo for 12 weeks. At week 12 the formula beat placebo on single-leg step-down repetitions to pain 2 and pain 5 and on VAS pain; after a half-marathon only that group kept its range of motion.

items.title_zh: 上海普陀：家医「1+1+1」签约超 62 万，慢病管理配 AI 健康处方
items.title_en: Shanghai Putuo signs 620,000 residents to family-doctor contracts, adds AI health prescriptions
items.source_zh: 上海市普陀区人民政府
items.summary_zh: 上海普陀区披露：全区家庭医生「1+1+1」签约居民超 62 万，服务延伸至商务楼宇与产业园区；万里社卫中心深化慢性病「五位一体」全链式管理，依托 AI 系统生成个性化健康处方，高危人群规范管理率保持高位；甘泉社卫中心把康复延伸至站点与居家，形成「住院—门诊—站点—居家」连续链条。区人民医院还开通肠镜社区对接一站式通道。
items.summary_en: Putuo District in Shanghai reported more than 620,000 residents signed to the 1+1+1 family-doctor contract, with services extended into office towers and industrial parks. Wanli community health centre deepened five-in-one chronic-disease management, using AI to generate personalised health prescriptions and keeping high standardised management rates among high-risk groups; Ganquan extended rehabilitation to satellite sites and homes, forming a hospital-to-home chain. The district hospital also opened a one-stop colonoscopy referral pathway.

items.title_zh: 卫健委回应「签而不约」：推动二三级医院给家医留专家号与床位
items.title_en: Health commission answers 'signed but not seen': hospitals told to reserve appointments and beds for family doctors
items.source_zh: 福泉市人民政府（转国家卫生健康委）
items.source_en: Fuquan Municipal Government / National Health Commission
items.summary_zh: 针对网民反映家庭医生「签而不约」，国家卫生健康委基层卫生健康司回复称，下一步将推动更多二、三级医院赋予家庭医生一定比例的专家号、住院床位等资源，为其提供门诊、检查、住院服务；进一步落实慢性病长期处方，推动基层用药与二三级医院衔接；加强与签约居民主动联系，为确有需要者提供家庭病床等服务。
items.summary_en: Responding to residents who say family-doctor contracts are signed but rarely used, the National Health Commission's primary-care department said it will push more secondary and tertiary hospitals to reserve a share of specialist appointments and inpatient beds for family doctors, covering outpatient, testing and admission services. It will also expand long-term prescriptions for chronic disease, align grassroots formularies with hospital formularies, and offer home sickbeds to those who need them.

items.title_zh: 民盟中央提案：农村慢病防治要按「南北病谱」分区分策
items.title_en: Policy proposal: rural chronic-disease control needs region-specific strategies in China
items.summary_zh: 民盟中央在《人民日报》提案指出，农村慢病谱地区差异明显：北方以高血压、糖尿病等代谢性疾病高发，南方多见风湿性关节炎、肺结核，统防统治难度大；居民主动体检意识弱、早期诊断率低。建议加大设备与适宜筛查系统投入、把慢病管理接入国家信息系统、改善全科医生考核补偿，并在东部推智慧居家管理、西北西南推远程医疗。
items.summary_en: In a People's Daily policy proposal, the China Democratic League notes sharp regional differences in rural chronic disease: metabolic conditions such as hypertension and diabetes dominate in the north, while rheumatoid arthritis and tuberculosis are more common in the south, complicating uniform programmes. It urges investment in equipment and appropriate screening tools, national information-system integration, better pay and evaluation for general practitioners, smart home management in the east and telemedicine in the northwest and southwest.

items.title_zh: 四川「三医」协同会议：服务从「病人」转向「全民」，强基稳二优三
items.title_en: Sichuan aligns health, insurance and pharma policy, shifting from treating patients to serving everyone
items.summary_zh: 11 月 19 日，四川省研究「三医」协同工作暨省中医药强省领导小组会议召开。省长施小琳提出推动服务从「以治病为中心」转向「以人民健康为中心」、从服务「病人」转向服务「全民」；深化「人口地图」「健康树」应用，「强基、稳二、优三」优化机构布局，推行医疗集团与医共体，健全长护险评估与支付体系，并通过家庭医生签约推动资源下沉。
items.summary_en: On Nov 19 Sichuan held a meeting on aligning medical services, insurance and pharmaceuticals. Governor Shi Xiaolin called for shifting from disease-centred care to people-centred health and from serving patients to serving the whole population. The province will deepen its population-map and health-tree tools, strengthen primary care while stabilising secondary and optimising tertiary institutions, promote medical groups and county consortia, refine long-term care insurance assessment and payment, and use family-doctor contracting to move resources downward.
